name: 坚果伴食纯藕粉冲调款
description: 深绿国风纯藕粉套图：粉质微距、四步冲调、坚果伴食、规格信任全链路

styleLock.direction: new-Chinese-style premium food commerce (oriental ink-green with gold line accents)
styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep ink-green textured panels #1E5B4A alternating with warm beige #EFE3CE; thin antique-gold flowing lines and line frames #C9A063 as the only decorative geometry
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm studio light around 4800K, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, appetizing warm tone, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: woven linen mat, dark walnut wood board, matte ivory ceramic bowls and shallow ivory risers
styleLock.typography: one modern song-ti serif display family for all Chinese headline and label text; no brush scrawl, no mixed fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line lotus flower and lotus leaf motifs plus small solid circular or hexagonal badges, single accent color, low complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; product always centered as the subject, raw-material props and illustrations never cover it; stable rounded info-card language across infographic shots
noDrift: no cover-over of the product by props or illustrations
styleLock.lockText: {style_lock} consistent new-Chinese-style premium food visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep ink-green #1E5B4A, warm beige #EFE3CE, powder ivory #F7F3EC and one vermilion accent #C23A2B, with thin antique-gold line accents #C9A063; soft warm studio lighting around 4800K with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; one modern song-ti serif display family for all headline and label text; consistent thin-line lotus motifs and small solid circular badges; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.textZone: top 35% vertical headline area: 「{selling_point_1}」 in ivory #F7F3EC, one small vermilion seal block #C23A2B, one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」

provenance.notes: 源自单张详情页长图切出的 8 张 800×1200 面板。归类依据：图中主品为多屏重复出现的碗装白色冲调粉，并含冲调步骤版面（四步操作），鲜藕仅作原料与质感展示，非鲜藕销售，故按 taxonomy 判定归 食品饮料/冲调（先例：红糖姜茶、黑麦麦片、枸杞），不落生鲜粮油。已剥离：品牌书法大字标题与原文案、功效养生类断言文案、红底六角徽章重复文案、会员二维码与全店促销角标；克重/产地/保质期/储存等不可验证参数统一收敛为 {callout} 文案槽，由使用方按实际商品填写。图中杏仁坚果伴食、粉碗微距、鲜藕切面等可见形态提炼为 props 与命名特征。
